items.label: About AIClient
items.content:
# AIClient

The `AIClient` is an ultra-fast, 'zero-dependency' JavaScript class to communicate with the **Pollinations AI API**. It supports text generation, streaming, image generation, and has built-in memory (history) for conversations.

### Features

*   **Auto Model Detection**: Automatically detects if a model generates text or images.
*   **Streaming Support**: Real-time text display with `onStream` callbacks.
*   **History Management**: Built-in memory that is easily disabled.
*   **Robust Images**: Generates images directly as `Blob` objects.
*   **Consistent Config**: Pass options directly to `generate()` or set globally in the constructor.

```html
<!-- Add to your HTML -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.4-test24.js"></script>
```

items.label: Quick Start
Constructor Options
items.content:
# Constructor Options

When creating a `new AIClient()`, you can pass an options object to set global defaults.

### Overview

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `string` | `null` | **Required**. Your Pollinations API key. |
| `model` | `string` | `"openai"` | The model ID to use (e.g., `openai`, `flux`, `gemini-fast`). |
| `systemPrompt` | `string` | `"You are a helpful..."` | The system instruction for text models. |
| `historyLimit` | `number` | `10` | Number of conversations to remember. Set to `0` to disable. |
| `stream` | `boolean` | `false` | Default streaming on/off for all requests. |
| `timeout` | `number` | `60000` | Timeout in milliseconds. |
| `seed` | `number` | `null` | Seed for reproducible results. |
| `width` / `height` | `number` | `1024` | Default dimensions for images. |

### Example

```javascript
const ai = new AIClient({
  apiKey: "sk_...",
  model: "gemini-fast",
  historyLimit: 5,
  systemPrompt: "You are a helpful assistant."
});
```

items.label: Method Chaining
items.content:
# Method Chaining

You can modify configuration using chaining methods. This is useful for changing settings on a single instance before calling generate.

### Available Methods

*   `.key(string)` - Set API key.
*   `.model(string)` - Change the model.
*   `.prompt(string)` - Change the system prompt.
*   `.timeout(number)` - Change the timeout.
*   `.seed(number)` - Set a seed.
*   `.dimensions(w, h)` - Set image dimensions.

### Example

```javascript
const ai = new AIClient();

// Configure for text
textResponse = await ai
  .key("YOUR_KEY")
  .model("openai-fast")
  .generate("Tell me a joke");

// Reconfigure for image on the same instance
imgBlob = await ai
  .model("flux")
  .dimensions(512, 512)
  .generate("A beautiful car");
```

Auto Model Detection
items.content:
# Model Detection Logic

The client fetches the list of available models from `https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models` upon first use.

### How it works

1. The client checks the `output_modalities` of the selected model ID.
2. If the output modality contains `"image"`, the **Image API** is used.
3. Otherwise, the **Chat Completions API** is used.

### Fallback

If the model list cannot be fetched, the client uses an internal list of known image models (`flux`, `zimage`, `kontext`, `gptimage`, `seedream5`).

This ensures you don't have to worry about endpoints; just choose a model and the client handles the rest.

```javascript
// This automatically goes to /v1/images/generations
await ai.generate("...", { model: "flux" }); 

// This automatically goes to /v1/chat/completions
await ai.generate("...", { model: "openai" }); 
```
